title: Antarctica & Greenland Polar Ice Mass Loss (2002–2025)
source: NASA GRACE & GRACE-FO Satellite Gravimetry Mission

records.explanation: 2002 GRACE Launch Baseline (0 Gt): Calm, low-volume baseline cryo-tone.
2005 (-410 Gt lost): Initial ice shelf thinning raises tension pitch slightly.
2008 (-890 Gt lost): Melt rate accelerates to 148 Gt/yr; volume & pitch climb.
2012 Extreme Melt Year (-1,540 Gt): Sharp 650 Gt drop triggers high-delta alarm harmonic!
2016 (-2,110 Gt): Over 2 trillion tonnes of polar ice lost. High-pitch warning synth.
2020 GRACE-FO Record (-2,680 Gt): Rapid West Antarctic grounding line retreat.
2025 Cumulative Loss (-3,290 Gt): Maximum anomaly! High-pitch siren & bass sub-drop.
